orange.$description: APPROVED BRAND COLOUR: Orange (#FF7A3A), primary. Mandatory accent in every layout, printed piece and social post. Never for text, buttons, links or full backgrounds behind text.

lime.$description: APPROVED BRAND COLOUR: Lime Green (#D4E6A8), primary. Default background. Text on it: Charcoal only. Charcoal text only.

lavender.$description: APPROVED BRAND COLOUR: Lavender (#E5DCFF), primary. Default background. Text on it: Charcoal only. Charcoal text only.

warm-white.$description: APPROVED BRAND COLOUR: Warm White (#FDFCF7), primary. Default background, replacing pure White. Text on it: Charcoal only. Charcoal text only.

navy.$description: APPROVED BRAND COLOUR: Navy (#1F3A6E), primary. Occasional background for covers and standout moments. Text on it: White only. White text only.

teal.$description: APPROVED BRAND COLOUR: Teal (#0F6E6E), primary. Occasional background for covers and standout moments. Text on it: White only. White text only.

blue.$description: APPROVED BRAND COLOUR: Blue (#3F00EB), primary. Flexible usage, including backgrounds and primary buttons. Text on it: White only. White text only. Digital only, never print.

charcoal.$description: APPROVED BRAND COLOUR: Charcoal (#1E1E1E), primary. Text and logo only. Never a full background.

white.$description: APPROVED BRAND COLOUR: White (#FFFFFF), primary. Text and logo only. Never a full background; use Warm White.

pink.$description: APPROVED BRAND COLOUR: Pink (#FADCD2), secondary. Occasional backgrounds, graphs, charts and supportive UI elements. Text on it: Charcoal only. Charcoal text only.

yellow.$description: APPROVED BRAND COLOUR: Yellow (#FFD84D), secondary. Decorative shapes, marks and accents on Navy or Teal backgrounds only. Never for text or backgrounds.
